text.lead: Hard Breakers is a 2011 American comedy film directed by Leah Sturgis and starring Sophie Monk, Cameron Richardson, Tom Arnold, Tia Carrere and Chris Kattan.
text.cast:
- Cameron Richardson
- Sophie Monk
- Tia Carrere
- Tom Arnold
- Chris Kattan
- Mircea Monroe
- Alexis Arquette
text.release: The film was released in select theaters on May 20, 2011.
text.reception: The film has a 14% rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Paul Schrodt of Slant Magazine awarded the film two stars out of four.
